dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nka, amma bɔ́ bamanankan, a ka kan jàma kɛ́lɛ yé?
dialogue.translation: Yes, but in reality, does it make all people the same?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kɔ̀, a ka kan jàma kɛ́lɛ yé, amma a bɔra mín san fanga.
dialogue.translation: Thus, it makes all people the same, but it also creates differences.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: O yé, globalization ka paradoxes ye san kɛ́lɛ.
dialogue.translation: Yes, the paradoxes of globalization are very clear.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mín bɛ́n kɛ́ túman jàma ma kɔ́, amma mín bɛ́n kɛ́ fanga ye.
dialogue.translation: We connect all people in the world, but we also create differences.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kɔ̀, globalization ye san kɛ́lɛ paradox kan.
dialogue.translation: Thus, globalization is a clear paradox.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: O yé, a ka kan jàma bɔ́ bamanankan ma kɔ́, amma a bɔra mín san fanga.
dialogue.translation: Yes, it connects all people in reality, but it also creates differences.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Globalization ye san kɛ́lɛ paradox, amma a ka kan jàma bɔ́ bamanankan ma kɔ́.
dialogue.translation: Globalization is a clear paradox, but it connects all people in reality.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sɛbɛn bɛɛ ka fili sɔrɔ tɛmɛ sayensi?
dialogue.translation: What are the limits of scientific knowledge?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sɛbɛn bɛɛ sɔrɔ, k'an mɛn tɛ fili kɔlɔn.
dialogue.translation: Limits exist, because we don’t know everything completely.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bɔra bɛɛ mɛn sara tɔgɔ wɛrɛkɛla?
dialogue.translation: Is it even possible for us to find all the tools?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Tɔgɔ bɛɛ sɔrɔ, nka mɛn tɛ sara kelen.
dialogue.translation: Tools exist, but we haven’t searched completely.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kelen fili bɛɛ sɔrɔ tɛmɛ sayensi?
dialogue.translation: Is complete knowledge even possible within science?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sayensi ka sɛbɛn bɛɛ sɔrɔ, k'an tɔgɔ tɛmɛ bɛɛ kelen.
dialogue.translation: Science has limits, because the tools within it aren’t complete.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mɛn bɛɛ sara, nka fili tɛmɛ bɛɛ sɔrɔ.
dialogue.translation: We are searching, but knowledge within it still exists.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kɔlɔn fili bɛɛ sɔrɔ, nka sɛbɛn bɛɛ ka sɔrɔ.
dialogue.translation: Complete knowledge exists, but limits still exist.
